ayahs.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind

ayahs.en: From the evil of the retreating whisperer
ayahs.e2: from the evil of the lurking whisperer—

ayahs.en: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind
ayahs.e2: who whispers into the hearts of humankind—
ayahs.tr: Al lazee yuwas wisu fee sudoorin naas

ayahs.en: From among the jinn and mankind
